# Borrowed references, vendored

These four are the override path's regression coverage: references the chart packet
deliberately does not own, applied to prove that any local DESIGN.md themes the corpus.
They were copied from the style generator's examples so the suite does not fail when that
sibling is pruned or regenerated. They are fixtures, not stock: nothing here themes from them.

Only the `DESIGN.md` of each is carried. Their `tokens.json` sidecars came across on the first pass
and were removed once measured: all four declare their theme on their own `**Theme:**` line, so the
sidecar changes nothing, and the four files were thirty-seven thousand lines of JSON that no
assertion read. Verified by deriving all four with and without them and comparing both themes.
